story.titleZh: 美国大奖赛周五回顾：车队分析数据，准备调整赛车
story.summaryZh: 车队将在今晚分析数据，寻找调整空间，以期在排位赛中提升赛车性能。
story.originalTitle: "We'll go through the data tonight, look at where we can make adjustments and see if we can improve the car ahead of Qualifying." Debrief our Friday a...
story.summaryEn:
"We'll go through the data tonight, look at where we can make adjustments and see if we can improve the car ahead of Qualifying."
Debrief our Friday at the #USGP:https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-united-states-gp
detailZh:
“我们今晚将分析数据，看看我们可以在哪里进行调整，以及是否能在排位赛之前提升赛车性能。”
周五在#USGP的简报：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-united-states-gp
detailEn:
"We'll go through the data tonight, look at where we can make adjustments and see if we can improve the car ahead of Qualifying."
Debrief our Friday at the #USGP:https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-united-states-gp
